findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_insider_activity, get_news_feed · Private data: get_stock · Public sink: get_market_assessment, get_insider_activity, get_stocks, get_screener · Destructive: get_stock, get_market_assessment, get_analyst_trend.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_insider_activity, get_news_feed · Private data: get_stock · Public sink: get_market_assessment, get_insider_activity, get_stocks, get_screener · Destructive: get_stock, get_market_assessment, get_analyst_trend

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
